thread:
sam: Heads up — small but urgent, EU embeddings Canary (model-embed-v3) rolled to 10% ~6m ago and we're seeing a 503 spike for long requests in eu-west1. :rotating_light:

dion: Confirmed on metrics — p95 token latency jumps and 503s correlate with requests > 1024 tokens. Impacting a handful of mid-tier customers.

lina: Logs show K/V cache misses in the new quantized path. Repro locally on v3 with long seqs. Suspect memory spilling on the new kernel.

maya: Can we pin to previous variant (model-embed-v2.1.3) for eu-west1 only? Customer success already queued heads-up for impacted accounts.

sam: Need expedited approval to pin canary and stop rollout. Two approvals (eng-sre + release-manager) to proceed per process — @dion @carol please?

carol: I can approve now. Agree with pin. Post-rollback smoke tests required.

dion: +1 from eng-sre, but request we also block automatic retries that might amplify errors. I'll patch the retry policy for the region.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout id=cr-20260320-1832 started -> status: failing in eu-west1, 10% -> queued actions: pause, pin, rollback.

sam: Running pin command (will target only eu-west1):
```
rover deploy pin --service embeddings --version v2.1.3 --region eu-west1 --reason "503s on long sequences in v3 canary"
```

lina: After pin completes I'll trigger a targeted rollback job for the nodes running v3 and run the KV cache warmup. Will monitor memory and token latency.

maya: Ops-oncall, can you hold capacity for a brief surge window for smoke tests?

ops-oncall: Sure — reserving extra slots for eu-west1 for 30m. I'll disable autoscaler bump for the pinned cohort to avoid noisy autoscaling.

sam: Who's on note-taking for release notes and incident entry? We should document the pin, root-cause hypothesis, and follow-ups. Link to draft: https://confluence.internal/redwood/embeddings-v3-pin-draft

carol: I'll append rollout timeline and customer list. Add a regression test to prevent this quantized kernel path for >1024 tokens.

dion: Approving final step once pin command finishes and smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:

sam: Executed pin. deploy-bot: any status?

deploy-bot: Action complete: pin applied to eu-west1 -> all new requests routed to model-embed-v2.1.3. Canary paused.

lina: Rollback job started, KV cache warmup in progress. First smoke checks look green (~5m). No new 503s observed.

sam: Thanks all. Postmortem to be scheduled; short-term follow-ups: revert quantized kernel flags for v3, add regression test for long-sequence embeddings, and a blind canary run on staging.

maya: I'll notify CS + affected customers with an ETA for fix.

dion: Leaving the thread open for 1 hour, then I'll close the incident if stable. :white_check_mark:
